Appreciate the help,

Mina/Laura — reviewed the incident export. Short summary: the regression is tied to the routing TTL logic when traffic shifts across regions leading to repeated cold starts; fix is straightforward but we need a controlled rollout and some additional QA. ETA: patch in 3 business days, full rollout in 7.

Commercial recommendation: propose a one-time credit equal to 25% of May forecasted usage (we estimate $18k) capped at $20k, contingent on no prior contractual credit for a related incident in last 12 months. Rationale: preserves goodwill, limits precedent, aligns with expected revenue impact from the outage window.

If we need faster approval, I suggest we offer a provisional 10% immediate credit while we finalize the exact amount — that buys GammaHealth breathing room for procurement.

Proposed messaging to customer (short):
"We sincerely apologize for the disruption. Engineering will ship a targeted patch with full rollout in 7 days. As a one-time accommodation, Redwood can apply a credit of up to $20,000 (proposed 25% of May forecast) or a provisional 10% credit immediately while we confirm final impact and rollout. We'll provide written confirmation for Procurement to accept on the invoice."

I'll attach the internal incident ticket in case you want more technical detail.

—Connor
